taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Funded issuance and transferable bearer gift-card value lifecycle
controls.source_trace: Trace each benefit to its authoritative debit/credit and eligibility rule, including partial redemption, rollback and refunded issuance.
controls.implementation_branch: Track issued, available, reserved, redeemed and refunded value separately. An optimistic balance may later reconcile without permitting extra spend. Show two authoritative debits/credits or another forbidden benefit under the same eligibility rule before classifying a duplicate-redemption defect.
controls.operational_method: Specialize in the funded issuance and transferable bearer-card lifecycle. Retain funding/capture, activation, transfer, redemption and reversal entries for one synthetic instrument; separate deliberately unfunded promotional value. Verify issued spendable value against authorized funding/credit and track the owner of each debit when a card changes hands. Knowing a display code is not proof of a valid bearer secret or authority to redeem someone else card.
controls.controlled_verification: Use synthetic funding, activation and transfer entries for one test card, then redeem and reverse under the owner policy. Compare spendable issuance against funding/promotional authority and ensure the same debit/transfer is not counted twice.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A displayed balance change is not additional spendable value; verify ledger and redemption authority, not UI arithmetic.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Preserve value conservation and atomic redemption, then test legitimate partial use, replay rejection and rollback.
